standard-dialogue-attempting-to-enter-th.npc: I wouldn't advise going down there before you know the risks, adventurer.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-enter-th.text: Player walks over to the Mysterious Stranger and begins the next dialogue

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Welcome adventurer, to the Hallowed Sepulchre. Are you here to claim some of the treasure within? It seems like the kind of activity one like you would appreciate.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Treasure? What treasure? And what do you mean by 'one like me'?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: If the player is not wearing a full set of vyre noble clothing:

steps.npc: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city. We could use someone of your talents.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: If the player is wearing a full set of vyre noble clothing:

steps.npc: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city... although you do smell and look like one. We could use someone of your talents.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Oh? I can't say I'm not interested. What do you propose?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: This place was built long before the city of Darkmeyer existed, back when this land was known as Hallowvale.
The Sepulchre was used as a resting place for Hallowvale's loyal followers of Saradomin.
Before they were driven out by the vampyres, the Saradominists used their magic to safeguard this place.
The dead here were buried with the wealth they had in life. To protect these riches, the Saradominists enchanted the statues within the Sepulchre to create various defences.
Many have tried and failed to obtain the prizes buried here.

steps.player: Okay... So I presume you want me to get some of this treasure for you? How should I go about doing it?

steps.npc: We don't care for a lot of what is kept here. We are only interested in the old currency of this land.

steps.text: The mysterious stranger pulls a coin out of their pocket and shows it to you.

steps.npc: If you find any of these Hallowed marks, I'd be willing to take them off your hands. In exchange, I can provide tools that can help you within the Hallowed Sepulchre.

steps.player: Okay... So I presume you want me to get some of this treasure for you? Does Efaritay know about this? It doesn't seem like the kind of thing she would appreciate.

steps.npc: It was actually on her orders that we first started doing it. She was very keen for us to gather as much of the old currency of this land as possible.

steps.text: The Mysterious Stranger pulls a coin out of their pocket and shows it to you.

steps.player: Hallowed marks... But why do you still need them? Drakan is gone now.

steps.npc: Yes... There was some debate over if we should end our work here. It is true that the icyene in particular was keen to see it come to an end.
However, the tombs have already been desecrated. That cannot be undone now, and while Drakan may be gone, it is wise that we be adequately prepared for any possibility.
So, with that in mind, if you find any hallowed marks, I'd be willing to take them off your hands. In exchange, I can provide tools that can help you within the Hallowed Sepulchre.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: You can keep whatever else you find for yourself.
You should know, only the most agile of adventurers will have success down there. You'll need to use your reflexes to overcome the traps within.
The Sepulchre has five floors in total, each more dangerous than the last. I hope you prove competent enough to make it all the way down.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Do you have any information about what kind of traps I can expect?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: The statues have been enchanted to shoot fire, lightning and arrows. Some also throw swords. There are also tiles that when stepped on, will teleport you somewhere else.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Sounds like the perfect challenge for me! Is there anything else I should know?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Yes... It seems that there is another safeguard which prevents anyone from spending too long within the Sepulchre.
You'll only have so much time before the magic within seals both the coffins and the stairs leading to the next floor.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Hang on a second... If the doors to the next floor close, then how will I escape?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: The priests who built this place had a teleportation system. The magical obelisks they used can be found at the end of each floor. These obelisks can be used to transport you back here.
However, we have found that the obelisks only respond to those they perceive to be followers of Saradomin. I'd strongly advise against wearing items of any other god.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: I see, but what if I'm in the middle of a floor and can't make it to an obelisk?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: I see you are cautious adventurer. That is wise. You can use any teleport spell to escape from the Hallowed Sepulchre. However, you may also find these of use.
These teleport crystals were enchanted using the magic of the obelisks. They can be used to teleport to this lobby. I can sell you more when you run out.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Thanks! I'll make sure to put them to good use.
Thanks for the information. I'll keep an eye out for some of those Hallowed marks.

steps.player: Tell me about yourself.

steps.npc: Like you, I am not from here. I represent a group who are very interested in the Hallowed marks found within the Hallowed Sepulchre.

steps.text: If the player has completed A Night at the Theatre:

steps.player: You know, I helped out a very similar individual to yourself over at the Theatre of Blood. Any connection?

steps.npc: So you're the one who the master spoke of. I am aware of your contributions. Helping us out here will earn yourself further favour with him.

steps.player: How do I know that's something I even want?

steps.npc: That is for you to decide. I have told you all that I have to share.

steps.text: If the player has not completed A Night at the Theatre:

steps.npc: That is all you need to know.

steps.player: All right then, keep your secrets.

steps.npc: I am one of the aranei in service to Father Sugadinti. I believe you are quite familar with our kind now.

options.text: I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.

steps.player: I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.

steps.npc: Of course.

options.text: Do you have any of my items?

steps.player: Do you have any of my items?

steps.text: If the Mysterious Stranger does not have any of the player's items:

steps.npc: I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.

steps.text: If the Mysterious Stranger has any of the player's items:

steps.npc: I do have some of your items here. Try not to get hit by the traps next time.

options.text: I'd like to access your tool storage.

steps.player: I'd like to access your tool storage.
Is there any way I could have private access to the Sepulchre? The other adventurers in there keep activating traps and messing up my timing.

steps.npc: An interesting problem. But... I suppose I could grant you private access to the Hallowed Sepulchre... for a fee.

steps.player: How much?

steps.npc: 200 Hallowed marks.

steps.text: If the player has less than 200 Hallowed marks in their inventory:

steps.player: I don't have that many marks on me...

steps.npc: Then I'm afraid that, for now, you will have to contend with your peers activating traps for you.

steps.text: If the player has at least 200 Hallowed marks in their inventory:

steps.prompt: Buy private access for 200 Hallowed marks?

steps.npc: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, you will end up in different chambers to your peers.
Speak to me again if you like this effect rescinded.

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.npc: Very well. I shall be here if you change your mind.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: I see you're still alive adventurer. Do you have any Hallowed marks for me?
